notes.title: Hex Kingdoms - Devlog#3 (Balloons)
notes.notes:
Hello there again!

We wanted to share a bit more information about most fascinating thing in Hex Kingdoms - the balloons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176123/4039a9c0d43c80251abd3227c4269d32d9f9fe78.jpg[/img]

Yes, balloons. Players will be able to build the workshop and craft transport balloons, that will take up to 2 units per balloon. They are fast, have great range and can give enemies a heart attack when they fly around in huge numbers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176123/87edd7ba603be4ea93f51ebd9f815835874a1a68.jpg[/img]

But beware! Balloons can be shot down by towers and cannoneers.

notes.title: Unlucky Seven will be out on August 30!
notes.notes:
Unlucky Seven will be released just in few days! Many of you have waited for this. 

[i]Elen's friends always remember to celebrate special occasions. Instead of attending Alcoholics Anonymous meeting, they go to a birthday party in a luxury motel. Unfortunately, the owner just ate a delicious human liver sausage. And the appetite comes with eating. The party of their life becomes a part of their death.

Experience the thrill of adventure through the beautiful pixel-realistic world, where you are who you eat, and your choices decide the fate of your friends. Meet the hidden goals and desires of each character and jeer as their plans are ruined.

Unlucky Seven will take you on a spacewalk and tell you a story about love, hate, and craving for human flesh.[/i]

Available on August 30, 2019:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/579120/Unlucky_Seven/

notes.title: Hex Kingdoms - Devlog#2 (Game Updates)
notes.notes:
Hello again! 

Hex Kingdoms is going smoothly and we want to give you some insight about units in game.

As we are not keeping big armies in game, but chose to give players control over individual fighters, it is important to know how they play. Preparing a different set of specialised units will alter the battle each time you play.

What can we expect from the game?

1. Lizard-Man: ground unit that can also move on water. May not be the strongest one around but can definitely catch your enemies off guard if you send a few of them from behind and create a diversion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176123/73bb987469bf1fe541bc8fe2cf774550d9d4235a.png[/img]


2. Canonneer: ranged unit that can operate second line of attack. But beware, canonneers can't attack enemies in close proximity of 1 hex.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176123/fd9a1c0d4746cca77b27317cb1358b15cf513c4b.png[/img]


3. Heavy Knight: slow, durable and powerful warrior. Can withstand a lot of blows but cost a lot and can't move at far distances. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176123/50781bcd2906d105bbf2dcd96096114de6c01fc9.png[/img]


More to come next time!

Take care.

notes.title: Hex Kingdoms - Devlog#1 (Introduction, updates, plans)
notes.notes:
Hello all! 
We are the developers of Hex Kingdoms and we will be giving you updates and devlogs once in a while before the premiere.

First of all, we want to say 'thank you' for the awesome support. The amount of positive reactions, emails, feedback and personal notes exceeded our expectations. That's why we decided to go on with better communication here, on Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176123/ec7eec456d53a1c2a6f6680ce6fc12344140312b.png[/img]

As many of you may now know, Hex Kingdoms will be heavily focused on skirmish custom games, but we will also offer arcade mode.
At this moment we are working on making AI a formidable enemy in the game.

Thanks to your feedback we decided to keep 3 different buildings for unit types, instead of maing them all in one place.

We will soon start discord channel for Hex Kingdoms and let you know when to roll.

Take care!

notes.title: Demo for When I Was Young is now available on steam!
notes.notes:
Hi Folks,
we just published a new demo for our upcoming 2D, retro-style game - When I Was Young.

You can install DEMO for free here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078650

[h1]About game[/h1]
When I was young is the story of an ordinary American guy who went to the Vietnam war to find his lost in action brother. You have an exciting and risky journey into a world full of deadly dangers, whether it is a painterly jungle or charming city streets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/3daf282742e2a9205dce8242954a9966af0d7384.jpg[/img]

[i]Cheers,
Rafal - Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.[/i]
